aboutGame.title: What is Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms?
paragraphs: Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms is a Three Kingdoms-era sandbox strategy RPG from developer Free Wing. You step into the late Han dynasty as a ruler, general, or free-roaming character, then build your own story through recruitment, diplomacy, trade, marriage, and turn-based battles across a living map of ancient China.

Battles are decided before they begin: faction synergy, formations, troop counters, and gear matter as much as raw power, while hero bonds and skill investment carry a roster through the campaign, guild content, and PvP. This wiki gathers the guides, tier lists, and data tables that keep your account moving in Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms.

items.question: What is Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms?
items.answer: Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms is a Three Kingdoms-era sandbox strategy RPG from developer Free Wing. You play as a ruler, general, or free-roaming character and shape your own story through kingdom building, recruitment, diplomacy, trade, marriage, and turn-based battles.

items.question: Which faction should beginners pick in Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms?
items.answer: There is no single best faction in Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms. Wei rewards control and burst damage, Shu leans on sustain and frontline heroes, Wu favors speed and ranged pressure, and Qun offers flexible picks. Choose the archetype that matches how you like to fight, then build a squad that shares its bond bonuses.

items.question: How do I get free rewards in Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms?
items.answer: Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms codes are the fastest source of free currency, summon scrolls, and upgrade materials. Redeem them in-game before they expire, and check the codes page regularly because most gift codes are tied to launch milestones, holidays, and livestreams.

items.question: Does Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms have a tier list?
items.answer: Yes. The Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms tier list ranks generals from S to C by role fit, scaling, investment efficiency, and faction synergy. Treat it as a snapshot, since balance patches and new releases shift the meta over time.

items.question: What platforms is Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms on?
items.answer: Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms is available on PC through Steam, where it also ships with 37 achievements and receives regular balance updates.

items.question: Where can I find Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms guides?
items.answer: This Heroes Vow Three Kingdoms wiki collects beginner guides, character builds, combat tactics, faction breakdowns, gear references, and achievement roadmaps in one place, so you can move from your first campaign stage to late-game PvP without leaving the site.
